rcc8 po

RCC-8: Partial Overlap (PO) — regions overlap but neither is part of the other.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Location -> gmeow:Location

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:rcc8po from gmeow:Location to gmeow:Location when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Location

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to assert RCC-8 Partial Overlap — regions overlap but neither is part of the other; symmetric.

Avoid when

  • Avoid it where one region is a proper part of the other (use gmeow:rcc8tpp / gmeow:rcc8ntpp).

How to use

  • Assert exactly one RCC-8 relation per region pair.

Examples

  • ex:a gmeow:rcc8po ex:b.
